summary: Fresh cross-asset and official-calendar checks found no new macro regime break. Oil, dollar strength, euro weakness, French spread stress, and the modest equity pullback extend already-recorded energy-inflation and global discount-rate/fiscal-risk regimes. No confirmed IEA reserve implementation decision was available, and the decisive EIA inventory and FOMC-minutes releases were still pending at the evidence cutoff.

Dollar index 102.49, euro $1.1166, USD/JPY 158.265; October Fed-hike probability 21.6% and December 68.6%; moves corroborate the existing rates/fiscal-risk regime.
Only informal IEA discussion was reported; no confirmed implementation decision, product split, or incremental volume was available.
IEA stated 325 million barrels of the March 400 million barrel collective action had been made available and refined-product constraints remained severe.
Calendar review preserved the release cutoff; the EIA inventory release had not yet occurred.
FOMC minutes were scheduled for 2026-10-07T18:00:00Z and were not yet available at cutoff.
